name: ARK public liquidity-pair burn and reserve collapse
summary: ARK exposed an unrestricted function that burned tokens held by its ARK/WBNB pair and synchronized the reduced reserve. The attacker repeated it 6,794 times, then swapped against the collapsed ARK reserve and withdrew the pair's WBNB.
notes: The direct deployment fixed the defect-bearing token runtime.

The exploit receipt contains the only two WBNB transfers: 0.000000000000000100 WBNB from the attack helper to the pair and 348.147268515623217950 WBNB from the pair to the attacker EOA. Their net is the exact pair loss. The USD value uses the nearest DefiLlama BNB observation preceding the transaction.
Replaces the seed row's rounded 348 BNB / $194,776 estimate with the transaction-exact WBNB balance flow and a pre-incident price observation.
